description: The strategies anyone can rent to run a Cubicle spot vault (today: accumulate, which buys a fixed amount of ETH or BTC on an interval up to a budget and never sells): what each does, its parameters, the venues and assets, the limits the vault itself enforces, the fee, how to rent it, and its honest status (not live with real funds yet). Beside them, scripts.proven: the cubicle.scripts the reader gate PROVED (their own trades beat random entries under the same exit, on discovery and on a later confirmation), each by its shape and its proof, never its rules; a script that is not PROVEN is never listed.
name: strategies
